news.title: News
news.listIntro: Prepare, review and publish bilingual news. Approval does not publish an item.
news.createIntro: Start a draft, then complete both languages in the editor.
news.detailIntro: Manage the editorial revision separately from the live revision.
news.liveUnchanged: The current live revision remains unchanged until this editorial revision is approved and published.
news.editorIntro: Save the draft before submitting for review. Both languages are required to submit; incomplete drafts can be saved.
news.readOnly: You can view this draft but do not have editing permission.
news.saved: Draft saved. The edit version is up to date.
news.unsaved: Save your changes before submitting for review.
news.selfApproval: You cannot approve a revision you submitted. Another reviewer must approve it.

approvedState.PUBLISHED: This editorial revision is approved and ready to publish. The currently published revision remains visible to the public until this revision is published.
approvedState.NEVER_PUBLISHED: This revision is approved and ready to publish. The News item has not been published yet.
approvedState.UNPUBLISHED: This revision is approved and ready to publish. The News item is currently unpublished.

news.restoreIntro: Need to correct this approved revision? Restore its content into a new editable draft, then submit it for review again.
news.editPublishedIntro: The existing published revision will remain live while this new draft is edited.

fields.title: Title
fields.bodyHint: Write the article in plain text. Line breaks are preserved. HTML and markup are not interpreted.

events.RESTORE: Restored to a new editing revision

results.return: Returned. A new editable revision was created.
results.approve: Approved. It has not been published yet.
results.publish: Published. The approved revision is now live.
results.unpublish: Unpublished. Revisions and history are preserved.
results.edit: New editorial revision created; the previous live revision is unchanged.
results.restore: A new editable revision was created from the approved content. The live revision is unchanged.

errors.generic: The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.denied: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.NEWS_NOT_FOUND: This News item could not be found.
errors.NO_ACTIVE_REVISION: There is no active editorial revision.
errors.NO_REVISION: No revision is available to edit.
errors.INVALID_WORKFLOW_STATE: The state changed. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.ACTIVE_REVISION_EXISTS: There is already an active editorial revision. Refresh the page.
errors.CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION: Someone else changed this draft. Refresh the page before continuing; your changes were not saved.
errors.TRANSLATION_INCOMPLETE: Complete the required Arabic and English title, summary, body and slug before submitting.
errors.INVALID_BODY: Enter plain article text without HTML or other markup.
errors.INVALID_SLUG: Use a slug made of letters or numbers separated by hyphens.
errors.SLUG_ALREADY_IN_USE: A published or reserved URL already uses this slug. Restore to editing to correct it, then submit for review again.
errors.INVALID_REFERENCE: One or more assigned categories are unavailable.
errors.RETURN_COMMENT_REQUIRED: Enter a reason for returning this revision.
errors.SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN: You cannot approve your own submitted revision.
errors.NOT_PUBLISHED: This item is no longer published. Refresh the page.

managedPages.title: Managed pages
managedPages.listIntro: Prepare, review and publish bilingual managed pages. Approval does not publish a page.
managedPages.createIntro: Start a draft, then complete both languages and the shared block structure.
managedPages.detailIntro: The editorial revision is separate from the live revision.
managedPages.liveUnchanged: The live revision stays unchanged until this editorial revision is published.
managedPages.editorIntro: Arabic and English share one block structure. Save before submitting. Both languages are required to submit.
managedPages.readOnly: You can view this page but do not have editing permission.
managedPages.unsaved: Save your changes before submitting for review.
managedPages.restoreIntro: Restore creates a new editable revision. It does not change the live page.
managedPages.editPublishedIntro: The published revision stays live while the new draft is edited.
managedPages.abandonIntro: Abandon this draft to clear the active revision without publishing it.
managedPages.previewBanner: Preview. This revision is not the public page.
managedPages.previewIncomplete: This language has no saved content yet.
